fact: A Bank of Sierra Leone presentation of 1 July 2025 lists Financial Consumer Protection Guidelines (2022) and E-money Guidelines (2022, including customer redress) among its DFS regulatory instruments, and Mobile Money Regulations 2024 as yet to be finalized.
title: Deep Dive on Quality Assessment of DFS - A Regulatory Perspective
publisher: Bank of Sierra Leone, Other Financial Institutions Supervision Department (ITU Workshop on Telecommunication Service Quality)
